thread:
anna: Quick check — onboarding mpt-7b-xyz for serving. We have two weight artifacts: s3://redwood-models/mpt7b/xyz/gptq/ and s3://redwood-models/mpt7b/xyz/awq/. Which one should we point dedicated pool at for initial canary?

mike: prefer AWQ for latency/cost, but FP8 profile looks promising. Are calibrations done for AWQ?

devon: Calib dataset ran on `calibset-v3` — AWQ done but only 2k samples. FP8 hasn't been calibrated yet. Accuracy delta on our eval harness: AWQ ~ -0.9% vs float, GPTQ ~ -0.6%.

lina: Tokenizer note: this model's tokenizer has an extra BOS token when using the legacy tokenizer. Using `tokenizer=vocab_v2` is required to avoid double-bos. See snippet:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('vocab_v2.json')
```

mike: Thanks — will update model config. Can someone paste the serving `models.yaml` entry we expect?

devon: Paste:
```yaml
model_name: mpt-7b-xyz
weights_path: s3://redwood-models/mpt7b/xyz/awq/
tokenizer: vocab_v2
quant_profile: awq-int4
calib_dataset: s3://redwood-calib/sets/calibset-v3
```

anna: Ops question: do we need both AWQ and GPTQ artifacts in the catalog for auto-fallback?

lina: Yes — routing policy prefers AWQ, fallback to GPTQ then FP8. Need compatibility metadata in `manifest.json` (seq_len, kv_cache_layout).

devon: I ran config validation script `tools/validate_model.py` — only warning was `kv_cache_layout` missing for GPTQ artifact. Should we require it before canary?

mike: Yes require it. Also request a perf bench run: `bench/latency --model mpt-7b-xyz --profile awq-int4` and attach numbers.

anna: I've uploaded bench results to link: https://redwood/bench/182007 — AWQ p50=42ms p95=120ms on v100. Can we get FP8 numbers?

devon: FP8 not calibrated; will run overnight and post.

calib-bot: Calibration job finished for FP8: accuracy drop -1.1% vs float on small eval. artifacts at s3://redwood-calib/results/mpt7b/fp8-calib/

lina: Given tradeoffs, approve AWQ canary for dedicated pool for 24h. @mike can you create the rollout with 10% traffic? :thumbsup:

mike: Creating rollout now. `api.rollout.create(model='mpt-7b-xyz', variant='awq', percent=10)`

anna: thanks, will watch metrics and open a regression ticket if quality dips.
